newsitem.title: FRANCE: French industry sees 1997 investment up 7 pct.
newsitem.headline: French industry sees 1997 investment up 7 pct.

text.p: French competitive-sector industry expects its investment, in real volume terms and historically adjusted for underestimation, to rise by seven percent next year, an October survey of business leaders by national statistics office INSEE showed.
They cut their expectations for the rise in investment in 1996 to four percent.
In the last survey in April, industrialists said they expected investment to increase nine percent in 1996. The October survey was the first forecast for 1997.
Investment in competitive industry represents only 30 percent of productive investment in France.
